title: An internal work order shows one badge and an orange header card
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a desktop browser at least 1440 pixels wide.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in Estimate.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • One "Internal" badge shows next to the status.
  • The header card has an orange outline and a light orange background.
  • No hint sentence shows under the header.
  • The customer card shows no badge and no category.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R3: “The work order header shows one badge next to the status: "Internal" for an internal work order, "No Charge" for a no-charge work order (a different style from Internal), in the desktop and the mobile header. It is the only mark on the work order: the customer card on the detail page shows no badge and no category. On the detail page the header card of an internal or no-charge work order has an orange outline and a light orange background (a new style for the header card, on desktop and on the mobile header; the design authority names the token), so the work order is recognised at a glance; there is no hint sentence under the header. The category of a no-charge work order is not shown on the work order; it is in the Change category dialog, on the NO CHARGE document and in the report (S2-R16). A billable work order that carries no-charge lines carries no badge and no header style; the line carries the mark (Story 12).”
  • Feature Overview: “Both look and work like a normal work order until the end. Estimates, approvals, parts ordering, picking, receiving, clocking and the review step work exactly as today. Lines show quantity, cost and hours and no sell prices: no labor rate, no part price, no totals, no tax, no fees, no discounts. Shop supplies is one flat amount (below). Nobody zeroes anything. One badge, "Internal" or "No Charge", shows next to the status wherever the work order appears, and on the detail page the header card is outlined in orange so nobody invoices it by habit.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
